title: 翡翠水庫大壩~Feitsui Dam
focus: 雙曲率拱壩與原水品質取水~Double curvature arch support and raw water withdrawal
summary: 翡翠案例結合拱壩的水平傳力與垂直懸臂、基岩層面有效應力、溫度接縫和水庫分層取水。課程將防洪蓄量、溢流消能及原水混合分開建模，避免把水位、濁度和結構安全視為同一指標。每個推導均要求確認幾何、量測基準與不能外推的條件。~The Feitsui case combines horizontal arch transfer and vertical cantilever response with bedding-plane effective stress, thermal joints and stratified withdrawal. Flood storage, spillway dissipation and raw-water mixing are modeled separately so that level, turbidity and structural response are not confused. Each derivation requires explicit geometry, measurement references and limits on extrapolation.
history: 翡翠管理機關列出雙曲率變厚度拱壩形式，壩高一百二十二點五公尺。水利署回顧記載一九八七年六月完工，並描述基礎岩盤處理的工程背景。教材不使用舊有總庫容冒充今日有效庫容，也不把示範材料強度宣稱為工程檢測結果。美國拱壩方法目錄與墾務局附屬構造索引提供研究方向，沒有取代本地正式規範。與石門土石壩的比較用於說明傳力及滲流機制的差異，而非優劣排行。~The reservoir authority identifies a variable-thickness double-curvature arch dam with height 122.5 m. A WRA retrospective records completion in June 1987 and discusses foundation treatment. The course does not substitute historical gross storage for current usable capacity or present assumed strengths as project test results. American arch and appurtenant-structure reference indexes provide research directions rather than applicable local approval criteria. Comparison with Shihmen illustrates differences in load transfer and seepage mechanisms and is not a ranking of the two projects.
example: 假想有效水量二千萬立方公尺、平均取水每秒四立方公尺，以體積除流量得名目停留時間五百萬秒，約五十七點八七日；實際水齡仍受密度流與短路影響。另設水平拱剛度三千、垂直懸臂剛度二千兆牛頓每公尺，在總力五十兆牛頓下，拱分擔三十兆牛頓。若拱剛度下降百分之二十，拱分力成二十七點二七三兆牛頓。這是共同位移的雙彈簧模型，不應拿分力直接宣布壩體安全。 核驗：V=20000000 m3; Q=4 m3/s; tau=V/Q/86400=57.87037 day。核對體積是有效交換區還是總庫容，將流量平均時段寫清楚。用水溫或保守示蹤物的深度剖面辨識隔離水層，再比較不同取水高程的到達時間，檢查名目周轉是否掩蓋短路。~Assume 20 million m3 of active water and mean withdrawal of 4 m3/s. Volume divided by flow gives a nominal residence time of five million seconds, or 57.87 days; actual water age still depends on density currents and short circuiting. Separately, arch and cantilever stiffnesses of 3000 and 2000 MN/m share a 50 MN force, giving the arch 30 MN. Reducing arch stiffness by twenty percent changes that share to 27.273 MN. This common-displacement spring analogy identifies redistribution, not a verified stress field or a dam safety conclusion. Verification: Check whether volume represents active exchange or total storage and state the averaging period for discharge. Use temperature or conservative-tracer depth profiles to identify isolated layers, then compare arrival times at withdrawal elevations to assess possible short circuiting.

units.anchor: 名目停留時間與水齡~Nominal residence and water age
units.title: 名目停留時間與水齡~Nominal residence and water age
units.mechanism: 供水水庫的體積除以平均取水率得到名目周轉時間，適合比較儲水量與需求尺度。翡翠背景下的真實水齡還取決於密度分層、入流短路及死水區，所以這個商不能代表每滴水都在庫內停留相同天數。 名目時間只包含一個平均流率，若入流沿某深度快速通過，水庫可同時存在很年輕的水團與多年未交換的深層水。~Stored volume divided by mean withdrawal gives a nominal turnover scale useful for comparing storage and demand. Actual water age also depends on stratification, short-circuit inflows and stagnant zones, so the quotient does not describe the travel time of every parcel. A nominal time contains only one averaged flow. Rapid passage along one depth can coexist with young water parcels and deep water that exchanges much more slowly, creating a broad age distribution.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：V=20000000 m3; Q=4 m3/s; tau=V/Q/86400=57.87037 day。適用邊界：穩態體積與平均流量的尺度估算，沒有假設真實水庫完全混合。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: V=20000000 m3; Q=4 m3/s; tau=V/Q/86400=57.87037 day. Applicable boundary: A steady-volume and mean-flow scale estimate, without asserting complete mixing in the actual reservoir.
units.verify: 核對體積是有效交換區還是總庫容，將流量平均時段寫清楚。用水溫或保守示蹤物的深度剖面辨識隔離水層，再比較不同取水高程的到達時間，檢查名目周轉是否掩蓋短路。~Check whether volume represents active exchange or total storage and state the averaging period for discharge. Use temperature or conservative-tracer depth profiles to identify isolated layers, then compare arrival times at withdrawal elevations to assess possible short circuiting.
units.failure: 以整座水庫體積計算後宣稱污染會在該天數全部消失，忽略長尾水齡與沉積再釋出；短路可能讓部分新入流水更早抵達取水口，兩種偏差可同時存在。~Claiming that contamination disappears after one nominal residence time ignores long age tails and sediment release. Short circuiting can simultaneously deliver some newly arrived water much earlier to the intake.
units.misconception: 名目停留時間就是每滴水完全相同的水齡~Nominal residence time is the identical age of every water parcel
units.practice: 將有效交換體積減為原值七成，計算名目停留時間，再畫完全混合與短路兩種概念流路，說明單一平均數無法分辨何者。~Reduce the actively exchanging volume to seventy percent, recalculate turnover and sketch complete mixing and short-circuit pathways. Explain why the same nominal mean cannot distinguish their very different age distributions.

units.anchor: 曲面水平投影的水推力~Hydrostatic horizontal projected force
units.title: 曲面水平投影的水推力~Hydrostatic horizontal projected force
units.mechanism: 曲面上的水壓始終沿表面法線，水平分力可用垂直投影面積積分取得。翡翠拱壩背景的示範只計一塊假想投影條帶，不把合力直接當作壩基剪力，也不忽略曲面另外可能承受的垂直分量。 積分可用水平分力逐點相加，也可先投影再積分，兩種路徑在靜水條件下應一致，這提供幾何模型的獨立檢核。~Pressure acts normally to a curved surface, while its horizontal component follows integration over the vertical projection. This exercise treats a hypothetical projected strip rather than equating the result to foundation shear or discarding other force components on the curved body. The horizontal force may be integrated from local components or calculated after projection. Under hydrostatic conditions these routes must agree, providing an independent geometric check without assuming a structural load path.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; b=10 m; H=40 m; F=rho g b H2/2/1e6=78.48 MN。適用邊界：頂端位於自由液面的垂直矩形投影，靜水且尾水壓未計。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; b=10 m; H=40 m; F=rho g b H2/2/1e6=78.48 MN. Applicable boundary: A vertical rectangular projection starting at the free surface, with hydrostatic water and no downstream pressure.
units.verify: 畫出隨深度線性增加的壓力三角形，用底壓乘面積再除二重算合力。核對作用點在水深下方三分之二位置，並列出曲面法線方向與水平投影之間的轉換，避免面積重複計入。~Draw the triangular pressure distribution and independently recover force from half the base pressure times projected area. Check that the resultant acts two thirds of the depth below the surface, then distinguish actual curved area from its horizontal-force projection.
units.failure: 把平均水壓誤設為底部最大水壓會使合力加倍；又若把投影條帶的合力直接均分給所有拱圈，便忽略深度變化與三維承載分配，產生錯誤應力圖。~Using bottom pressure as average pressure doubles the resultant. Distributing the projected-strip force equally among every arch ring then ignores depth variation and three-dimensional load sharing, producing a misleading stress picture.
units.misconception: 曲面水平水推力可直接用底壓乘全部曲面面積~Horizontal hydrostatic force equals bottom pressure times the entire curved area
units.practice: 把水深從四十公尺增至四十八公尺，計算合力倍率並比較壓力倍率，解釋為何總推力增加快於底壓，以及投影寬度假設有何影響。~Increase depth from forty to forty-eight metres, compare force and bottom-pressure multipliers, and explain why resultant force grows faster. State how the assumed projected width limits the interpretation of the comparison.

units.anchor: 拱與懸臂剛度分力~Arch and cantilever load sharing
units.title: 拱與懸臂剛度分力~Arch and cantilever load sharing
units.mechanism: 雙曲率壩的水平拱作用與垂直懸臂作用共同抵抗水壓。用同位移的兩個並聯彈簧表示這兩條力路，可看出較硬路徑分擔更多荷載，但這只是相容變形概念，不能把兩彈簧視為互不影響的真實壩塊。 總剛度相加來自同位移條件，與串聯彈簧的同力條件不同；分力比恰為剛度比，只在這個線性並聯模型成立。~Horizontal arch and vertical cantilever action jointly resist pressure. Parallel springs with a common displacement illustrate why the stiffer load path attracts more force, while remaining an analogy rather than two independent physical blocks of a real double-curvature dam. Adding stiffnesses follows from common displacement, unlike the common force of series springs. The force ratio equals the stiffness ratio only within this linear parallel model, not as a universal dam property.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：ka=3000 MN/m; kc=2000 MN/m; F=50 MN; Fa=F ka/(ka+kc)=30 MN。適用邊界：線性並聯與共同位移，只示範力路分配，不提供局部應力。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: ka=3000 MN/m; kc=2000 MN/m; F=50 MN; Fa=F ka/(ka+kc)=30 MN. Applicable boundary: Linear parallel paths with shared displacement illustrate force distribution without predicting local stresses.
units.verify: 分別用總剛度求位移，再以兩個剛度乘位移重建分力，確認分力相加等於外力。改變其中一條路徑剛度時，同時記錄另一條分力如何增加，並說明真實壩體需要何種接縫及基礎資料。~Find displacement from total stiffness, recover each force from stiffness times displacement and verify equilibrium. Change one path stiffness while tracking the other force, then identify joint and foundation information required to move beyond this simple compatibility analogy.
units.failure: 認為一條力路變軟只會減少整體受力，漏掉荷載向另一力路轉移；若仍保留原分力卻改用新剛度，則位移不相容，模型已失去共同變形的基本前提。~Softening one path does not simply remove load; it redirects force into the other path. Keeping old force shares with new stiffnesses creates incompatible displacements and violates the model's central assumption.
units.misconception: 一條力路變軟不會改變另一條力路的分力~Softening one load path leaves force in the other path unchanged
units.practice: 把拱剛度降至二千四百兆牛頓每公尺，重新求兩條分力及共同位移，畫出荷載轉移方向，指出這項結果仍不能判定局部裂縫是否擴展。~Reduce arch stiffness to twenty-four hundred meganewtons per metre, recalculate both forces and displacement, and draw redistribution. Explain why these results alone cannot determine whether a local crack will propagate.

units.anchor: 岩盤層面有效正向力~Effective force on rock bedding
units.title: 岩盤層面有效正向力~Effective force on rock bedding
units.mechanism: 拱推力進入有層面的岩盤時，抗滑摩擦取決於扣除孔隙水壓後的有效正向力。假想單一平面模型把水壓作用面積明列出來，讓學員看見排水如何改變有效力，而不是把總壓力全部當成可用摩擦來源。 孔壓作用的方向垂直層面，水壓與總正向力使用相同符號約定才能相減；孔壓上升不是直接增加摩擦的壓緊力。~Thrust entering bedded rock mobilizes friction according to normal force remaining after water pressure is deducted. A single-plane model explicitly includes pressurized area, showing how drainage changes effective force rather than treating total compression as entirely available for friction. Pore pressure acts normal to the bedding plane, so it must use a compatible sign convention with total normal force. Increasing water pressure is not additional clamping force available to mobilize friction.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：N=80 MN; u=0.3 MPa; A=100 m2; phi=30 deg; R=(N-uA)tan(phi)=28.86751 MN。適用邊界：不計黏聚與側向約束，孔壓均勻；只算摩擦抗力不是安全係數。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: N=80 MN; u=0.3 MPa; A=100 m2; phi=30 deg; R=(N-uA)tan(phi)=28.86751 MN. Applicable boundary: No cohesion or lateral confinement, with uniform pore pressure; the result is frictional resistance, not a safety factor.
units.verify: 先核對兆帕乘平方公尺等於兆牛頓，再以測壓管代表範圍估算壓力分布。比較排水前後孔壓與位移趨勢，注意單一測點不能代表整條層面，並另列未知的剪力需求與力矩。~Verify that megapascals times square metres produce meganewtons, then examine how piezometers represent the pressure field. Compare pressure and movement before and after drainage, noting that one point cannot characterize the entire plane and that shear demand remains unspecified.
units.failure: 把總正向力直接乘摩擦係數會高估抗力；若測壓點位在局部低壓排水孔旁，可能漏掉遠處高壓區，使看似合理的平均孔壓掩蓋層面有效力不足。~Multiplying total normal force by friction coefficient overestimates resistance. A sensor beside a local drain may miss a remote high-pressure zone, so an apparently reasonable average can conceal reduced effective contact force.
units.misconception: 不必扣除孔隙水壓即可用總正向力算摩擦~Friction can use total normal force without deducting pore pressure
units.practice: 把均勻孔壓提高到零點四兆帕，重算摩擦抗力並畫孔壓與抗力關係，再討論何時有效正向力趨近零會使簡化接觸假設失效。~Raise uniform pore pressure to zero point four megapascals, recalculate resistance and plot its pressure dependence. Discuss why the contact assumption breaks down as effective normal force approaches zero.

units.anchor: 溫度變形與接縫開度~Thermal movement and joint gap
units.title: 溫度變形與接縫開度~Thermal movement and joint gap
units.mechanism: 拱壩接縫的相對開合會受到塊體溫度、拘束及水壓共同影響。自由熱伸縮長度可以當作幾何尺度，但不能直接等同實際縫寬；縫面接觸後可能傳力，張開後傳力條件又會改變，形成非線性問題。 若接縫兩側都朝縫面伸長，相對閉合量可能大於單塊伸長；若一起平移則縫寬不變，顯示絕對與相對位移不同。~Relative joint movement responds to block temperature, restraint and hydraulic loading. Free thermal movement provides a geometric scale rather than the actual gap, because contact can transmit force while opening changes the load path and introduces nonlinearity. When both blocks expand toward a joint, relative closure can exceed one block expansion. Common translation leaves gap unchanged, demonstrating why absolute movement and relative aperture are different observables.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：alpha=0.00001 1/K; L=24 m; dT=15 K; dL=alpha L dT*1000=3.6 mm。適用邊界：單一塊體自由伸長，未加入兩側塊體、拘束及初始縫寬。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: alpha=0.00001 1/K; L=24 m; dT=15 K; dL=alpha L dT*1000=3.6 mm. Applicable boundary: Free expansion of one block, excluding adjacent blocks, restraint and initial gap.
units.verify: 將縫計與附近溫度計同步繪圖，核對量測方向與正負號，再分別辨識日週期與季節週期。以兩側塊體的相對運動重建縫寬，不能把單側絕對位移直接當成開度。~Plot joint and temperature measurements synchronously, checking sensor direction and sign before distinguishing daily from seasonal cycles. Reconstruct gap from the relative motion of both sides rather than treating one block's absolute displacement as joint opening.
units.failure: 把自由伸長全數加到縫寬而不考慮方向，可能把閉合預測成張開；若縫面已接觸仍用同一直線關係外推，就會忽略接觸壓力與剛度突然改變。~Adding all free expansion to gap without checking direction can predict opening where closure occurs. Continuing the same linear relation after contact ignores the resulting contact pressure and abrupt change in stiffness.
units.misconception: 單塊自由伸長必然等於接縫實際開口增量~Free expansion of one block necessarily equals actual joint opening
units.practice: 畫兩側等長塊體同時升溫的幾何圖，指定固定端位置後求相對位移，再與單側伸長比較，說明接縫初始間隙對是否接觸的影響。~Sketch two equal blocks warming together, specify their fixed ends and derive relative movement. Compare it with single-block expansion and explain how the initial gap determines whether contact develops.

units.anchor: 密度分層與取水慣性~Stratification and withdrawal inertia
units.title: 密度分層與取水慣性~Stratification and withdrawal inertia
units.mechanism: 水庫冷暖水層的密度差提供恢復浮力，取水流速則會拉動界面。以約化重力及密度福祿數比較慣性與浮力，可討論選擇性取水是否容易擾動水層，但實際取水形狀、界面厚度與三維流場仍不可省略。 約化重力只保留密度差造成的浮力尺度，不能用完整重力取代；其平方根與水深共同形成可與流速比較的特徵速度。~Density contrast between warm and cool layers supplies restoring buoyancy while withdrawal velocity disturbs the interface. Reduced gravity and a densimetric Froude number compare inertia with buoyancy, without resolving intake geometry, interface thickness or the three-dimensional withdrawal field. Reduced gravity retains the buoyancy associated with density difference and cannot be replaced by full gravitational acceleration. Combined with depth under a square root, it produces a characteristic velocity comparable with withdrawal speed.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：g=9.81 m/s2; drho=2 kg/m3; rho=1000 kg/m3; h=8 m; v=0.2 m/s; Fr=v/sqrt(g drho h/rho)=0.50482。適用邊界：兩層近似、密度差小且水深為假想作用尺度，非設備臨界值。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: g=9.81 m/s2; drho=2 kg/m3; rho=1000 kg/m3; h=8 m; v=0.2 m/s; Fr=v/sqrt(g drho h/rho)=0.50482. Applicable boundary: A small-density-difference two-layer approximation with hypothetical depth scale, not an equipment threshold.
units.verify: 沿深度量測溫度與密度，確認界面存在並記錄測點時間，再用流量與有效進水面積估算局部速度。比較不同取水時段的剖面變化，留意風混合也可能造成界面移動而非全部由取水引起。~Measure depth profiles of temperature and density to establish an interface and record sampling times. Estimate local velocity from flow and effective intake area, then compare profiles across withdrawal periods while accounting for wind-driven mixing as an alternative cause.
units.failure: 把全庫平均流速代替取水口附近速度可能嚴重低估慣性；直接把無因次數當成固定允許值，也會忽略幾何、分層厚度與入流條件，使比較失去物理依據。~Reservoir-wide mean velocity can greatly understate inertia near an intake. Treating the dimensionless number as a universal permitted value ignores geometry, interface thickness and inflow conditions that control its interpretation.
units.misconception: 密度福祿數有適用所有取水口的固定允許值~Densimetric Froude number has one fixed permitted value for all intakes
units.practice: 將密度差減半而保持速度不變，重算無因次數並描述浮力恢復變弱的意義，再列出需用水槽或數值模型確認的取水口幾何效應。~Halve the density difference at unchanged velocity, recalculate the dimensionless number and explain weaker buoyant restoration. Identify intake-geometry effects requiring physical experiments or a resolved flow model.

units.anchor: 颱風入流與短時水位~Storm inflow and short term level
units.title: 颱風入流與短時水位~Storm inflow and short term level
units.mechanism: 颱風期間水量累積取決於入流減放流的時程，水面積把蓄量差轉成水位差。以局部固定面積作近似可快速估計量級，但翡翠的真實地形曲線與隨水位變動的出口能力會使線性估算偏離實況。 局部面積就是庫容對水位的導數，因此固定面積近似只適合變動不大的一段高程；跨越地形突變時應分段處理。~During a storm, storage accumulates from the time history of inflow minus release. Local water area converts volume change into level change as a first approximation, while real geometry and level-dependent outlet behavior can depart from that linear estimate. Local surface area is the derivative of storage with respect to elevation. Constant area is therefore a local approximation, and a level change spanning abrupt topographic variation should be integrated in segments.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qnet=140 m3/s; dt=10800 s; A=8000000 m2; dH=Qnet dt/A=0.189 m。適用邊界：三小時淨入流與水面積固定，沒有指定實際蓄洪空間或放流規則。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qnet=140 m3/s; dt=10800 s; A=8000000 m2; dH=Qnet dt/A=0.189 m. Applicable boundary: Constant net inflow and surface area for three hours, without specifying real flood space or release rules.
units.verify: 用逐時入出流積分先求體積，再以相鄰高程面積曲線求水位並比較固定面積結果。保留初始水位及面積資料年代，查明降雨、側流和量測時間差是否已納入水量平衡。~Integrate hourly inlet and outlet flows for volume, then use neighboring elevation-area data to estimate level and compare with the fixed-area result. Retain initial level and survey date, checking rainfall, lateral inflow and measurement timing in the balance.
units.failure: 只用暴雨峰值流量乘整場歷時會放大蓄量；反之以日平均淹沒短時洪峰，可能低估最大水位。沒有初始水位的增加量無法判斷剩餘空間是否足夠。~Multiplying a storm peak by the whole event overstates volume, while daily averaging can suppress the maximum level. A level increment without the initial elevation cannot establish how much storage space remains.
units.misconception: 只知道水位增量就能判斷剩餘蓄洪空間~Knowing only level increment establishes remaining flood-storage capacity
units.practice: 把水面積改成隨水位增加的兩段值，分段解同一體積的水位增量，再比較固定面積近似的高估或低估方向，註明地形曲線的不確定性。~Use two surface-area segments that increase with elevation, solve the level change for the same volume and determine whether constant area overestimates or underestimates it, retaining uncertainty in the geometry curve.

units.anchor: 水躍共軛水深~Hydraulic jump conjugate depths
units.title: 水躍共軛水深~Hydraulic jump conjugate depths
units.mechanism: 溢流後的高速淺水若轉成低速深水，可透過水躍耗散能量。矩形渠道的動量平衡給出上下游共軛水深，這不代表任意尾水都能穩住水躍；實際消能池還受床面、空氣摻混及側向流動影響。 躍前與躍後流量相同但速度與水深改變，動量函數相等不代表比能相等，兩斷面的比能差才是耗散的量。~A hydraulic jump converts fast shallow flow into slower deeper flow while dissipating energy. Rectangular-channel momentum gives conjugate depths, but arbitrary tailwater will not necessarily hold the jump in place, and actual basins involve aeration, bed details and lateral effects. Discharge is conserved across the jump while depth and velocity change. Equal momentum functions do not imply equal specific energies; their specific-energy difference quantifies the mechanical energy dissipated in the transition.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：y1=1 m; v1=8 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; Fr1=v1/sqrt(g y1); y2=y1(sqrt(1+8Fr1^2)-1)/2=3.14663 m。適用邊界：水平矩形渠道、靜水壓斷面與一維動量；未提供真實消能池尺寸。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: y1=1 m; v1=8 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; Fr1=v1/sqrt(g y1); y2=y1(sqrt(1+8Fr1^2)-1)/2=3.14663 m. Applicable boundary: Horizontal rectangular channel, hydrostatic sections and one-dimensional momentum, without sizing an actual basin.
units.verify: 先用連續方程求下游平均速度，再核對兩斷面的動量函數接近相等，最後比較比能以確認能量下降。水槽觀察應記錄水躍位置與尾水變化，不能只量一張照片中的水深。~Use continuity to recover downstream velocity, check equality of momentum functions and compare specific energy to confirm dissipation. In a flume, record jump location as tailwater changes rather than relying on depths captured in a single photograph.
units.failure: 把共軛水深當成保證穩定水躍的尾水設定，可能忽略掃出或淹沒；若又把耗能量當作局部壓力，將無法辨識床面脈動、氣蝕與沖刷的不同機制。~A conjugate depth does not guarantee a stable jump; sweep-out or submergence may occur. Treating dissipated energy as local pressure also obscures distinct mechanisms of fluctuating loads, cavitation and scour.
units.misconception: 水躍同時保持動量函數與機械比能不變~A hydraulic jump conserves both momentum function and mechanical specific energy
units.practice: 將入口速度改為六公尺每秒，重新求共軛水深和出口速度，說明為何水躍高度改變，並列出需要尾水曲線才能判斷的定位問題。~Reduce inlet velocity to six metres per second, recalculate conjugate depth and downstream velocity, and explain the height change. Identify jump-location questions that require a tailwater relationship.

units.anchor: 含砂濃度與固體負荷~Sediment concentration and mass load
units.title: 含砂濃度與固體負荷~Sediment concentration and mass load
units.mechanism: 流量與懸浮固體質量濃度相乘得到輸入固體的質量率，可把集水區侵蝕與水庫占容問題串連。濁度是光學反應而非質量濃度，翡翠背景的教學不能不經現地校準就把濁度單位直接乘流量。 質量率積分得到的是運輸量，轉成沉積體積還要知道留下比例與乾容重，因而輸砂與庫容測量應分開設計。~Discharge times suspended-solids mass concentration gives a solids delivery rate linking catchment erosion to reservoir storage. Turbidity is an optical response rather than mass concentration, so it cannot be multiplied directly by flow without a site-specific conversion and its uncertainty. Integrating mass flux gives transported solids. Conversion to deposited volume additionally requires retention and dry bulk density, so sediment transport measurements and reservoir-capacity surveys address related but distinct quantities.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q=12 m3/s; C=0.35 kg/m3; dt=7200 s; M=Q C dt=30240 kg。適用邊界：兩小時代表濃度與流量固定，僅懸浮輸砂，不含推移質與庫內沉降。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Q=12 m3/s; C=0.35 kg/m3; dt=7200 s; M=Q C dt=30240 kg. Applicable boundary: Constant representative concentration and flow for two hours; suspended load only, excluding bed load and reservoir deposition.
units.verify: 同時採集斷面流量與混合代表水樣，以過濾乾燥法取得質量濃度，再用濁度建立有誤差範圍的輔助關係。檢查洪峰前後是否有遲滯，避免只採清水期而漏掉主要固體負荷。~Pair cross-section discharge with representative composite samples, determine mass concentration by filtration and drying, and use turbidity only through an uncertain calibration. Check rising and falling limbs for hysteresis so clear-water sampling does not miss the dominant solids load.
units.failure: 以單一岸邊樣本代表全斷面會漏掉垂向與橫向濃度梯度；把輸入固體全當作永久沉積，也會忽略排出、再懸浮與密度壓密，使庫容損失估算偏離。~One bank sample may miss vertical and lateral gradients. Treating all incoming solids as permanent deposition ignores passage, resuspension and compaction, so transported mass cannot directly establish lost reservoir volume.
units.misconception: 濁度數值可以直接當作每立方公尺固體公斤數~A turbidity value directly equals kilograms of solids per cubic metre
units.practice: 假設濃度在第一小時加倍而第二小時減半，分段求質量並比較原值，再說明若流量同步變動，使用兩個平均值相乘會有何偏差。~Double concentration in the first hour and halve it in the second, integrate mass and compare with the original case. Explain the bias from multiplying separate averages when discharge varies simultaneously.

units.anchor: 原水保守溶質混合~Conservative raw water mixing
units.title: 原水保守溶質混合~Conservative raw water mixing
units.mechanism: 不同深度原水混合後，保守溶質濃度由流量加權質量守恆求得。這個概念能教導取水來源比例的重要性，但濁度、藻類與會反應的物質不一定線性混合，不能把保守示蹤物公式套到所有水質指標。 質量守恆以溶質通量為基礎，濃度本身不能直接相加；每股流量權重的總和必須等於一，混合濃度應介於兩來源之間。~A conservative dissolved constituent mixes according to flow-weighted mass balance, illustrating the importance of source proportions. Turbidity, algae and reactive substances need not mix linearly, so the tracer equation is not a universal relationship for every water-quality indicator. Mass conservation applies to solute flux rather than concentration alone. Flow weights must sum to unity, and a conservative two-source blend should lie between the source concentrations when both flows are positive.
units.model: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q1=3 m3/s; C1=20 mg/L; Q2=2 m3/s; C2=50 mg/L; Cm=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2)=32 mg/L。適用邊界：充分混合、無反應的假想溶質，不表示濁度或飲用水合格限值。~Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Q1=3 m3/s; C1=20 mg/L; Q2=2 m3/s; C2=50 mg/L; Cm=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2)=32 mg/L. Applicable boundary: Complete mixing of a hypothetical nonreactive solute, not turbidity or a drinking-water acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以相同時段的兩股來源流量及濃度求輸入質量率，核對混合後取樣位置已有足夠混合距離。將預測值與出口樣本比較時，先補上停留時間，避免把不同水團的濃度直接相減。~Use simultaneous source flows and concentrations to calculate input mass rate and confirm that the outlet sample follows sufficient mixing distance. Account for travel time before comparing predicted and measured concentrations so different water parcels are not subtracted as if simultaneous.
units.failure: 拿濁度直接做保守濃度混合可能因顆粒絮凝而失準；若取樣位置尚未混勻，單點量值會偏向某股來源，即使整體質量守恆正確仍看似不符合公式。~Applying conservative mixing to turbidity can fail because particles flocculate. Before complete mixing, a single sample may favor one source, appearing to violate the equation even when the overall mass balance is correct.
units.misconception: 兩股流量不同時仍可把濃度直接取算術平均~Two concentrations can be averaged arithmetically even when source flows differ
units.practice: 維持總流量五立方公尺每秒，把較高濃度來源減至一立方公尺每秒，重算混合濃度並畫比例曲線，註明這只是保守溶質的教材。~Keep total flow at five cubic metres per second, reduce the higher-concentration source to one and recalculate the blend. Plot concentration against source fraction and label the conservative-solute assumption explicitly.
